profile.headline: Full Stack Developer
profile.summary:
Driven and experienced cloud based applications developer using key technologies and frameworks in Javascript and Java.  Experienced in joining and contributing to existing projects as well as starting a project from beginning to end including deployment and scheduled releases.

5 years of Agile experience developing customer driven applications with:
 React.js, Redux,  Express,  NodeJs, Typescript,  Next.js, Postgres, MySQL, DynamoDB, Docker, Mongo, GraphQL, GraphCMS, AWS S3, AWS Lambda, AWS CloudWatch, AWS RDS, AWS EC2, AWS Secrets Manager, AWS IAM, Java, Java Servlets,  and Java SpringBoot.  

5 years of DevOps experience using tools such as:
 CI/CD, Jenkins, Git, Git Action, Git Workflow, IBM Websphere,  Vercel, Terraform, Shell Scripts,  and Knex migrations.

positions.description:

Integrated a web map for automating the scoring process of transportation models.

Lead the team in effective communication with clients and liaisons.
